name: my-workout-tracker
description: Monorepo for a workout tracking app (progressive overload) — a fullstack Next.js web app (marketing + admin + Apple-login user/auth API) and an Expo mobile app.
_comment_reactPin: Single React across the monorepo (SDK 54's version). expo-router's dep tree resolves loose react ranges to a newer 19.x and hoists it, leaving mobile with two React copies -> 'Cannot read property useState of null'. Next 16 accepts ^19.0.0, so web is fine on 19.1.0 too. Bump alongside the Expo SDK's react.
_comment_expoFontPin: Pin expo-font to SDK 54's version. @expo/vector-icons declares expo-font as a peerDependency '>=14.0.4', so npm auto-installs the LATEST match (an SDK 57-era expo-font) and hoists it, shadowing the SDK 54 native module -> 'Cannot find native module ExpoFontLoader' on a dev build. Bump alongside the Expo SDK's expo-font.
_comment_optionalDependencies: Force the Linux x64 native binaries for Tailwind v4 (oxide) and Turbopack's CSS (lightningcss) into package-lock.json. npm only records the current-platform optional binary when you install on macOS, so Vercel (linux-x64) can't find them and the build fails with 'Cannot find module ../lightningcss.linux-x64-gnu.node'. Keep these versions in sync with the transitive lightningcss / @tailwindcss/oxide versions.
